# faultflow

> Open-source ATPG and fault simulation engine for Yosys gate-level netlists: SAT-based test generation (CaDiCaL), stuck-at and transition faults, scan insertion, IEEE 1500 wrapping.

## Docs
- [Getting started](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/faultflow/getting_started/installation.html)
- [User guide](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/faultflow/user_guide/tcl_shell.html)
- [Architecture](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/faultflow/architecture/overview.html)
- [Benchmarking](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/faultflow/benchmarking.html)
